items.author: AFpost
items.context: AF Post (@AFpost): Deutsche Bank, el banco más grande de Alemania, lanza servicios de custodia cripto para clientes institucionales y corporativos en Europa. Soporta Bitcoin, Ethereum y algunas stablecoins, y planea expandirse a Asia en 2027.
items.suggested_text: Banks offering custody shows the demand is real. It's also the opposite of what Bitcoin made possible: holding your own keys without trusting anyone. If you'd rather not depend on a bank, an exchange or a device vendor, I wrote a book on building your own air-gapped setup: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HQ5NS31N?dplnkId=c09ef739-11f3-4c76-8c62-92ce160a3341&nodl=1

items.author: dotkrueger
items.context: Fred Krueger (@dotkrueger): a 5 años del techo de 2021 (15-nov-2021), retornos desde entonces: BTC +3%, BNB −6%, XRP −18%, ETH −60%, SOL −70%, DOGE −77%, ADA −92%, DOT −98%. Dice que del top 10 de 2021 (sin stablecoins) solo Bitcoin vale más hoy: "There is Bitcoin. And there is crypto."
items.suggested_text: +3% in five years sounds weak until you see the rest of that top 10. Buying near a cycle top and still being the only one above water says a lot about what survives. The other lesson: entry timing matters less than not being forced to sell. $BTC

items.author: Sykodelic_
items.context: Sykodelic (@Sykodelic_) admite que se equivocó en la profundidad de la corrección: esperaba de $87.000 a ~$75.000 (máximo $72.000) y al perder $72.000 hubo una liquidación agresiva hasta $62.000. Enumera 7 señales estructurales de suelo de ciclo, compara la estructura con 2015 y dice que, mientras el precio no lo invalide, asume que el mínimo del ciclo está en $58.000; reconoce que podría invalidarse por primera vez.
items.suggested_text: Respect for owning the miss in public. Most accounts quietly delete. The part I'd keep in mind: signals that worked every past cycle still come from a small sample, so you size like they can fail. That's where spot without leverage lets you stay in the game. $BTC

items.author: W0LF0FCRYPT0
items.context: The Wolf Of Crypto Streets (@W0LF0FCRYPT0): dice que Bitcoin va a $30.000, que los hackeos son "parte del guion" y que en el último bear market BTC cayó de 69.000 a $15.476 (−77%); afirma que Bitcoin suele caer 70-80% en cada bear market y que esta vez no será distinto.
items.suggested_text: Each bear market drawdown has been smaller than the one before, so assuming another 77% is a choice, not a law. Could $BTC see $30K? Maybe. But a call with no invalidation level is just a mood. What would make you wrong?

items.author: iamkadense
items.context: Kadense Pengu (@iamkadense): un cierre semanal por encima de la línea "Do or Die" sería prometedor para $BTC; ve demanda clara por debajo del nivel, origen de los mínimos del bear market. Adjunta gráfico con los niveles semanales que vigila.
items.suggested_text: Weekly close is the right timeframe to judge this; intraday wicks have fooled everyone lately. If it closes back below, what's the next level you'd trust? Mapping both outcomes beforehand beats reacting on Sunday night. $BTC
